## 1. Executive Summary & Brand Overview
Mohan Dental Care (मोहन डेंटल केयर - एडवांस डेंटल & इम्प्लांट सेंटर) is the premier multispecialty dental hospital based in Surajpur, Chhattisgarh. It serves as the leading advanced oral healthcare destination for the entire Surguja division, encompassing Surajpur, Ambikapur, Manendragarh, Bhatgaon, Baikunthpur, and Ramanujganj.

The clinic is founded and directed by Dr. P. R. Rajwade, an alumnus of Government Dental College Raipur with extensive surgical and clinical experience from top healthcare institutions including BALCO Medical Center, Dentaproof Dental Hospital, and Government CHCs.

## 3. Clinical Services Catalog

### 3.1. Single-Sitting Root Canal Treatment (RCT)
- Indication: Deep cavities, severe toothache, dental abscess, pulp infection.
- Technology: Rotary endodontic handpieces, electronic apex locators, rubber dam isolation.
- Benefit: 100% painless procedure, saves the natural tooth without extraction.

### 3.2. Permanent Dental Implants
- Indication: Single missing tooth, multiple missing teeth, or completely edentulous jaws.
- Material: Biocompatible Titanium dental implants with Zirconia abutments and crowns.
- Benefit: Permanent tooth replacement that looks, feels, and functions like a natural tooth.

### 3.3. Orthodontics: Braces & Invisible Aligners
- Metal Braces: Traditional, highly effective for complex misalignment.
- Ceramic Braces: Tooth-colored brackets, discreet appearance.
- Clear Aligners (Invisalign type): Custom 3D printed transparent trays, removable for meals, zero food restrictions, virtually invisible.

### 3.4. Crown and Bridge Prosthodontics
- Zirconia Crowns: CAD/CAM milled, unbreakable high-strength aesthetic crowns.
- Emax Lithium Disilicate: Maximum natural translucency for front teeth smile makeovers.
- Metal-Ceramic (PFM) Bridges.

### 3.5. Ultrasonic Scaling & Dental Bleaching (Cleaning & Whitening)
- Ultrasonic Scaler: Vibration-based plaque and calculus removal without enamel scraping.
- Clinic Bleaching: In-office laser/LED activated teeth whitening, lifts stubborn tobacco, betel nut, pan, and tea/coffee stains.

### 3.6. Painless Wisdom Tooth Surgery
- Indication: Impacted, horizontally angled, or painful third molars.
- Technique: Minimally invasive flap surgery with specialized bone preservation instruments.

### 3.7. Pediatric Dentistry (बच्चों के दांत)
- Milk tooth fillings, pulpectomy, habit breaking appliances for thumb sucking, space maintainers.

### 3.8. Gum Therapy & Periodontal Care
- Treatment for bleeding gums, pyorrhea, bad breath (halitosis), and receding gum lines.

## 4. Clinic Infrastructure & Technology
- Digital RVG Sensor: Low-dose digital X-ray with instant high-definition screen review.
- Multi-Stage Class B Autoclave: Hospital-grade 134°C sterilization for complete infection control.
- Comfortable Ergonomic Dental Chairs: Vibration-free quiet operation for an anxiety-free visit.
- Clean Modern Operatory: Air-conditioned waiting lounge and sanitized treatment rooms.
